note: Rival lines on election night are night records with id 'night-rival-<rival id>' and moment 'majority' (said after your majority, 4.4); the runtime NightLine has no rival field, so the id is the link (requested).

rivals.name: Councillor Prudence Stitchley
rivals.backAgain: Councillor Stitchley is back for another go. Same hat. She has had it brushed.
rivals.resignation: Councillor Stitchley won, then resigned to spend more time with her hat.
rivals.note: slogan, resignation and night line given (spec 2.10, 4.4, style sheet 2)

rivals.name: Cyril Dunnock
rivals.backAgain: Cyril Dunnock is back for another go. He is waiting politely on the step.
rivals.resignation: Cyril Dunnock won, then resigned to spend more time with his doorbells. He has eleven.
rivals.note: hobby 'doorbells' as the style sheet has it; names.json role still says 'door knockers' (requested)

rivals.name: Philippa Setter
rivals.backAgain: Philippa Setter is back for another go. Her leaflet is a crossword. Nobody has finished it.
rivals.resignation: Philippa Setter won, then resigned to spend more time with her crosswords. Clue: rather busy (4).

rivals.name: Leander Waft
rivals.backAgain: Leander Waft is back for another go. The spoon has been polished for the occasion.
rivals.resignation: Leander Waft won, then resigned to spend more time with the Ceremonial Spoon. It is his turn to hold it.
rivals.note: slogan given; role line on papers is names.json's "Keeper, Ceremonial Spoon"

rivals.name: Hortensia Mallowby
rivals.backAgain: Hortensia Mallowby is back for another go. She has brought the accordion, and it has brought a tune.
rivals.resignation: Hortensia Mallowby won, then resigned to spend more time with her accordion. It folds up nicely.
rivals.note: the slogan is how an accordion is played, and how the desk is

rivals.name: Fergus Noonday
rivals.backAgain: Fergus Noonday is back for another go. He arrived at noon exactly, by his own reckoning.
rivals.resignation: Fergus Noonday won, then resigned to spend more time with his sundials. The afternoons, mostly.
rivals.note: weather no worse than cloud (style sheet 1)

rivals.name: Professor Ozias Kalends
rivals.backAgain: Professor Kalends is back for another go. He has started on Thursdays.
rivals.resignation: Professor Kalends won, then resigned to spend more time with his calendars. Effective last Wednesday.

rivals.name: Ottoline Strop
rivals.backAgain: Ottoline Strop is back for another go. She has brought her own chair, and a cushion for it.
rivals.resignation: Ottoline Strop won, then resigned to spend more time with her chairs. Standing down, she found, was tiring.
rivals.note: slogan given; role line on papers is names.json's "Folded Napkin (Second Class)"

rivals.name: Lettice Ringrose
rivals.backAgain: Lettice Ringrose is back for another go. She rang ahead to say so.
rivals.resignation: Lettice Ringrose won, then resigned to spend more time with her handbells. All twelve were consulted.

rivals.name: Aldous Mould
rivals.backAgain: Aldous Mould is back for another go. He says the heap has been building up to this.
rivals.resignation: Aldous Mould won, then resigned to spend more time with his compost heap. It needed turning.

rivals.name: Araminta Dovecote
rivals.backAgain: Araminta Dovecote is back for another go. She said she would be. They always come back.
rivals.resignation: Araminta Dovecote won, then resigned to spend more time with her pigeons. They had written to her.
rivals.note: homing pigeons; the pigeons are only kept and admired

rivals.name: Ivo Pharos
rivals.backAgain: Ivo Pharos is back for another go. He has brought a model lighthouse. It is switched on.
rivals.resignation: Ivo Pharos won, then resigned to spend more time with his model lighthouses. One needed a new bulb.

rivals.name: Honoria Lathe
rivals.backAgain: Honoria Lathe is back for another go. Her tapestry of the last attempt has a new corner.
rivals.resignation: Honoria Lathe won, then resigned to spend more time with her tapestry. It shows her winning, then resigning.

rivals.name: Quentin Furlong
rivals.backAgain: Quentin Furlong is back for another go. He has learned a second tune.
rivals.resignation: Quentin Furlong won, then resigned to spend more time with his harmonica. He played his notice.
rivals.note: a harmonica sounds on the breath in and out

rivals.name: Imogen Tessel
rivals.backAgain: Imogen Tessel is back for another go. She has done the edges.
rivals.resignation: Imogen Tessel won, then resigned to spend more time with her jigsaws. They are all sky. She prefers it.

rivals.name: Rufus Pantry
rivals.backAgain: Rufus Pantry is back for another go. He tapped the glass before coming. It said 'fair'.
rivals.resignation: Rufus Pantry won, then resigned to spend more time with his barometers. All of them saw it coming.

rivals.name: Gertrude Ambling
rivals.backAgain: Gertrude Ambling is back for another go. She walked here. It took a week, by choice.
rivals.resignation: Gertrude Ambling won, then resigned to spend more time with her walking boots. They were waiting by the door.

rivals.name: Bartholomew Knapp
rivals.backAgain: Bartholomew Knapp is back for another go. You may have heard him arrive.
rivals.resignation: Bartholomew Knapp won, then resigned to spend more time with his yodelling. He announced it from a hill.

night.text: Stitchley: I still own the hat.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: stitchley

night.text: Dunnock: Nobody is home, then. Understood.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: dunnock

night.text: Setter: Defeated. Eight letters. I checked.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: setter

night.text: Waft: The spoon and I will be fine. Gently.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: waft

night.text: Mallowby: I shall play something gentle on the way out.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: mallowby

night.text: Noonday: It was never my hour. It has clouded over anyway.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: noonday

night.text: Kalends: Very well. See you on Thursday.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: kalends

night.text: Strop: I shall remain seated. Thank you.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: strop

night.text: Ringrose: I shall ring once for you. Quietly.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: ringrose

night.text: Mould: Everything comes back, given time. So will I.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: mould

night.text: Dovecote: I shall send word. By the usual route.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: dovecote

night.text: Pharos: I shall leave a small light on for you.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: pharos

night.text: Lathe: I shall sew this evening in. Near the edge.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: lathe

night.text: Furlong: A short tune for the winner. Very short.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: furlong

night.text: Tessel: There is always one piece missing. I will look under the table.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: tessel

night.text: Pantry: The glass said this would happen. I did not look.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: pantry

night.text: Ambling: I shall walk home. The scenic way.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: ambling

night.text: Knapp: I shall be on a distant hill about this. Briefly.
night.note: the rival's line at the result: knapp

night.text: Good evening. I will open the envelopes in order.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: The envelopes have been sealed since noon. I have been sitting with them.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: Held. I will chalk it up.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: This one is held. Next envelope.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: Not held. Next envelope.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: This one goes to your opponent. Noted.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: That is a majority. The band may begin.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: That is a majority. Please do not cut anything yet.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: That is a majority for your opponent. I will read the rest, as is proper.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: Your opponent has a majority. The band will play something quieter.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: Envelope four.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural

night.text: That is the last envelope. Thank you all for staying. Mind the steps.
night.note: Agatha Tallow, straight and procedural
